g.text: International Development Institute Uganda · Plot 45 Wilson Avenue, Jinja · idiu.org

svg.text: How IDIU buys for its projects, and what this system keeps track of.

g.text: International Development Institute Uganda (IDIU) is a Christian non-profit based in Jinja, working with Korea Food for the
Hungry International (KFHI) and donors such as KOICA. Its projects reach communities in six districts:

svg.text: Each project's budget, line by line; a purchase must fit an active line.
Raised by staff, approved step by step by the right people.
RFQs to prequalified suppliers, compared or scored by a committee.
Orders, goods received, and the payment reference Finance records.
The best value, not just the lowest price.
Three or more quotes from prequalified suppliers.
Whoever prepares a record never approves it.
Every step is kept in the audit trail.
Example, to be set from IDIU's manual
